description_short: Endgame AI infrastructure, Recursive Epochs, and universal industry.
description_long: Rebuild a mature island around physical AI infrastructure. Integrate electronics and capital from Epoch II, reconstruct terrestrial industries from Epoch III, and invest in Civic Knowledge through a staffed Fiber-connected settlement service. Native source technologies, material costs, power, maintenance, and deliberate construction remain, with original landmark models and later orbital specialization.
